recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片多數細胞的細胞質布滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，核圓形或偏心，屬嗜酸性骨髓球等前驅細胞，另夾雜細胞質偏藍、顆粒較少的早期細胞與少數雙葉嗜酸性球，背景散落游離顆粒；嗜酸系大量增生。
features: Sheets of eosinophil precursors with round to eccentric nuclei
Cytoplasm densely filled with coarse purple-red granules, many with immature dark staining
Earlier granulocytic precursors with basophilic cytoplasm and sparse granules
Occasional mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and a small lymphocyte
Free granules scattered in the background from ruptured cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field dominated by eosinophil precursors with round or eccentric nuclei and cytoplasm densely packed with coarse granules, many retaining purple immature staining. Earlier granulocytic precursors with basophilic cytoplasm and sparse granules, occasional mature bilobed eosinophils and a small lymphocyte are also seen, with free granules in the background. Although precursors with basophilic cytoplasm are present, a definite blast excess cannot be established from this single field. Findings indicate marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, compatible with hypereosinophilic syndrome after exclusion of reactive, rearrangement-driven and leukemic causes by blast count, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Requires increased blasts (≥5% marrow) or a clonal abnormality, which must be established by a formal differential and cytogenetic/molecular testing.
Inv(16) shows increased myeloblasts and monocytic cells with abnormal eosinophils containing large dark basophilic granules; confirm by CBFB::MYH11 testing.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with FGFR1 or PDGFRB rearrangement
ddx.vs: Separated by karyotype/FISH for 8p11 or 5q32 rearrangements rather than morphology.
